tokens of the richest agent, as a share of all tokens
share of the agents in the 2-core

dropped.links: links per agent asked for a range, 3 to 12, and neither more nor fewer is simply better: agents on loops per link (`lean`) reads it against the loops the links make
dropped.max_tokens: the largest holding is the richest agent's share of all tokens, counted the other way round, so the two would cancel; its line kept out a world of paupers, which no living world is
dropped.genotypes_alike: a genotype is renewed by every mutation, so how many agents share one says how seldom brains mutate, not how differently agents act; the same-position share measures that
dropped.gini: drawn at B2's most even world, a baseline the screen no longer compares with; the Gini over a random deal's at the same mean holding reads the same thing against chance

orders.product: the six multiplied (read as their geometric average): a strong criterion makes up for a weak one in part
orders.sum: the six added (read as their average): a strong criterion makes up for a weak one in full
orders.worst: the weakest of the six: nothing makes up for it
